modules.description: SQL↔Rust↔API round-trip PBT for all 14 cognitive record types (Record, Entity, Alias, Mention, Evidence, Episode, Goal, GoalProgress, Source, ToolObservation, ConsolidationRun, RetrievalTrace, RetrievalTraceItem, Feedback). Extreme Unicode, empty optionals, time boundaries, malformed-row isolation (MGR-034).
modules.notes: 128 proptest cases per type. PBT confirms forward-compatible TruthState::Other and StalenessClass::Other round-trip correctly (design §40 unknown-field preservation).

modules.description: Unit tests for all memory model modules: relation_registry (canonical 5-link seed, direction/reflexivity/endpoint enforcement, alias resolution), record/entity/truth/temporal/provenance types, source ingestion, graph revision.
modules.notes: Covers: relation_registry DB tests (canonical row attributes, duplicate-name PK enforcement, all five canonical links directed/non-reflexive/non-writable, direction class CHECK constraint). All model invariants hold.

modules.description: All memory library unit tests: model, stores (sqlite_vectors, sqlite_graph cycle-termination), write_policy (incognito, injection-rejection, policy modes), authority (AuthorityTx, event log, idempotency, revisions), graph_intel, truth, semantic_parser, retriever, entity_resolution.
modules.notes: Includes sqlite_graph::tests::neighbors_terminates_on_cyclic_graphs — confirms BFS cycle-safety. Includes sqlite_vectors v2 tests: NaN/zero-norm/wrong-dimension rejection, cosine ranking correctness.

modules.description: 100-case authority property tests: atomicity, idempotency (same key replays), policy-mode rejection (incognito, disabled), Recovery_Mode write block, and 200-case cross-property sweep.
modules.notes: Each numbered test case counts as one (each exercises 100–200 generated inputs internally).

modules.description: Gate correctness hash summary, paired-world core filter, paired-world plugin filter, concurrent authority bus writes (10 tasks).
Policy engine, session manager, verifier, and transparency layer unit tests.
Authority survives restart with zero data loss; incognito leaves no trace across restart.

FTS5 offline operation, Unicode (CJK, RTL, Spanish diacritics), injection-shaped text, corruption recovery (content table survives FTS damage), no-results-with-filters, and query plan validation (FTS5 index — no full table scan).
modules.notes: query_plan_uses_fts5_index_not_full_table_scan and query_plan_unfiltered_uses_fts5_index both pass — confirms F2 FTS5 index is used correctly for semantic search.

modules.description: i1a_single_authority_connection FAILS: raw Connection::open found in policy/read_authorization.rs and authority/integrity.rs. This is a pre-existing invariant gap logged as NBW-F1-03 in the F1 manifest. Two other invariant cases pass. No new F2 regression introduced.
modules.notes: Not a F2 semantic model failure. Will be resolved in F3 retrieval-on-v2 cleanup.

f2CoverageNotes.V-TRUTH-01: Pass — truth/temporal model types round-trip; TruthState variants including forward-compatible Other round-trip correctly; supersession lineage preserved in unit tests.
f2CoverageNotes.V-ENTITY-01: Partial — SQL↔Rust entity/alias/mention round-trip proven by PBT (f2_1_5). Full merge/split/preview/reversal (CMD-MG-EVAL) is a planned target.
f2CoverageNotes.V-GRAPH-01: Pass — BFS cycle-termination confirmed (sqlite_graph::tests); direction/reflexivity/endpoint checks enforced by relation_registry. 3-hop depth enforcement and hidden-intermediary path suppression are in graph_intel and confirmed by unit tests.
f2CoverageNotes.V-IO-01: Partial — Interchange type round-trips proven by PBT (f2_1_5 RecordPayload/PolicyPartition/ValidInterval). Full export→import→export package test requires CMD-MG-EVAL (planned target, NBW-F2-01).
f2CoverageNotes.V-REG-01: Pass — existing memory lib tests all pass (1668); no regression introduced by F2 work.
